mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 59 degrees with overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park. The third quarter moon is out, and you can look forward to an overnight low of 52 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

October is Community Planning Month, with Mayor Diaz recognizing the Planning and Development Department for their dedication. Also, check out the tri-shaw Bike Program, which offers free rides on the Military Ridge State Trail via the Senior Center.
There is plenty to do, including the Dane County Farmers Market today and live music at Bailey's Run. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the World Dairy Expo and the Farley Center Fall Festival.
In a report covering September 14 to September 28, officers handled various incidents. On September 21, a suspect was identified through surveillance video and cited for the retail theft of candy.
Today's flavor of the day is Really Reese's. The store is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM, so there is still time to stop by for a scoop.
